approvals.reason: The mobile Sheet path returns before desktop sidebar markup renders, so the stock responsive display gates are redundant; removing them prevents Electron's generated responsive CSS from hiding the desktop sidebar while preserving the stock component structure and styling.
Sonner maps Omni's canonical persisted named theme to its required light/dark value; no visual drift or second theme authority.
Tooltips use the semantic popover surface with a border and shadow, and omit the malformed rotated Radix arrow so the shared component remains opaque and legible across themes.
